scope: Generic original visual root accumulation, marker callback phase and late UpdateSubObjects reconciliation
early_findings: Current MotionHandler immediately admits root motion through ActorMovement, publishes actor.transform.position and nativeBodies.set_position, before named marker events are dispatched. This collapses visual accumulation, game position admission and physical transform into one stage.

Original early Scene animation moves a DISTINCT VisualObject Root.position. GameObject.position160 and physical body transform are reconciled later; no fake visual-position getter may return actor position.

CharacterVisual owns compensated model/skeleton pose and root-track sampling, but currently has no independent actor-placement visual root. Renderer main supplies actor placement externally from ActorState.

Current source marker damage is synchronous at the Session callback, but that callback occurs after pose publication and immediate root-position admission. This is still later than original marker position/pose observation.

Source HandleDisplacement rotates/scales raw authored XY by actual visual root quaternion/scale, sets Z positive zero, and does not contain the motor analog-intent multiplier. That extra multiplier must not be silently called original visual-root math.

subobjects_sequence: VisualObject.Update0x470cf0 is genuinely empty; do NOT advance retained timelines a second time here
PhysicalObject.Update is an actual body service, not a visual position alias
Sample arrival from current game XY vs destination/path target, strict squared distance<6400
For awake body, only physical XY differences>1 replace game XY; exactly-one floor policy validates this replacement. Accepted physics position suppresses visual ApplyPosition
Apply original physical destination velocity policy if requested; otherwise set XY velocity zero

If PositionFromVisual and visual exists and physics not accepted: Visual.ApplyPosition0x47124c reads DISTINCT visual root; GameObject setter updates game position/auxiliary/AABB/body request and SyncPosition; wake body
Visual.SyncPosition copies final game XYZ into DISTINCT visual root, dirty bit8 and actual absolute-position backend; a physical body receives subsequent final game transform request
Apply visual rotation branch (base empty), or accepted awake physical angle; source visual rotation sync uses Euler(Y,-X,-Z) conversion, then scaling sync
When floor policy=false, trailing camera/floor validation occurs AFTER rotation/scaling; corrected body transform and second visual SyncPosition follow rejection/correction
Arrival resets destination to final game position; final AABB uses local bounds+gameXYZ; auxiliary and target-node caches update afterward

required_actual_borrows.name: VisualRoot
required_actual_borrows.cells: dh2::visual::Root position/quaternion/scale + animated/helper/secondary translations, presence and dirty flags
required_actual_borrows.rule: Canonical rendered visual-instance root. Distinct from ActorState and native body. Renderer/scene world backend MUST read this same storage; no stage-only phantom visual.

required_actual_borrows.name: GameObject
required_actual_borrows.cells: Game position160, Euler16c..174, heading178/1b8, destination1a8, source local/absolute bounds, PF cached position+24
required_actual_borrows.rule: Borrow existing actor/source owner fields via explicit transport projection with synchronous publication. PF previous-position cache is separate and refreshed by actual source validation.

required_actual_borrows.name: PhysicalObject
required_actual_borrows.cells: Sole POCharacter/native BodyState and TransformRequest; awake/pin/filter/velocity/query state
required_actual_borrows.rule: Reuse PlayableActorBodies same actor/body/world. Genuine physical service publishes SetXForm/velocity/wake at kernel-selected boundary.

required_actual_borrows.name: SourcePolicies
required_actual_borrows.cells: Actual flags520 virtual getters, ValidatePosition/floor/camera policy, actual source speed, visual/body presence
required_actual_borrows.rule: Use actual owner/focus fields; do not choose position-from-visual based on in-house CharacterAction.

required_actual_borrows.name: AnimatedLocalRoot
required_actual_borrows.cells: Current actual animated local translation selected by original GetAnimRoot, helper presence
required_actual_borrows.rule: Read actual blended node pose, not the raw delta scratch, actor position or root rest origin.

concrete_integration_path.existing_kernel_route: Use actor_runtime.cpp GenericVisualBorrowV4 + update_gameobject_v4, or an explicit borrowed-root staged adapter using dh2_visual_displace and dh2_subobjects_update_source_v69. Existing kernels already define phase/service semantics.
proposed_adapter_api: BorrowedVisualRootStages ctor(actual dh2::visual::Root&, actual GameObject/subobjects backing + optional same body/transform + genuine services)

update_subobjects_late(actual decoded policy + body views + source floor/camera/aux providers): native subobjects kernel; GameObject/body/visual writes occur only at original callbacks
visual placement accessor returns canonical visual root used by renderer, not ActorState.transform
root_wiring_tasks: Introduce renderer-owned actor visual placement root initialized by genuine source SyncPosition/SyncRotation/scaling calls; assign root services to actual CharacterVisual/model draw placement.

Keep CharacterVisual compensated model-space meshes + external visual placement ONCE, OR bake owner/helper into scene world skin palette and draw identity. Never use both placement paths or double helper compensation.

Rewire retained frame effects to preserve marker observation BEFORE early root accumulation; until sampler callback seam exists, reordered detached events fix only position ordering, not pose-sensitive FX or synchronous in-sampler reentry.
Early accumulated visual root uses prior visual quaternion. Later command/facing updates must not retroactively rotate that displacement.
Run real PhysicalWorld step and body update at proper phase, then late subobjects resolves awake physics acceptance vs visual root.
Use actual source floor validation only in the kernel-selected early/trailing branch, not an eager navigation solve for every animation delta.
Actual visual update callback is its proved empty source body; it must not call CharacterVisual.update or retained.advance and double sample wall time.
Record marker-observed game position, visual-root before/after accumulation, body transform timing and final synced root on actual player/NPC assets.

callback_and_damage_implications: actor_blended_playback.advance_slot calls observer while old pose/root and old GameObject position are still live, before compiled transform sampling for that slot.

Current RetainedPosePlayback publishes blended pose before RetainedAnimationOwner.collect records events. Session retained_services currently calls MotionHandler first and named_animation_event second.
To restore range/damage position semantics first, stop MotionHandler from publishing game/physical position early; keep game position unchanged until late ApplyPosition/physics reconciliation.
To restore visual-root observation semantics, deliver marker events before accumulating root.position.

Full pose-sensitive FX/socket/reentry semantics require an in-sampler synchronous callback seam and rereading live slot generation/weight gates. Merely reordering a detached final batch cannot claim that parity.

NewAnim selection frames also have immediate source callbacks/root-reset effects; retain source timestamp+1 reset/current sampling and physical same-resource extra, not an independent deferred synthetic delta queue.
meaningful_acceptance_checks: Marker range query observes previous game XYZ even when current animation frame contains a large lunge
Early visual root displacement leaves GameObject/body unchanged until late source policy permits ApplyPosition
Late awake physical displacement>1 wins and suppresses visual ApplyPosition; rejected floor point uses corrected body transform
Move/Attack floor-policy0 invokes trailing validation after rotation/scaling; Idle floor-policy1 does not invent the same trailing solve
Prior visual yaw rotates early root; later GameObject rotation affects only subsequent source displacement, and sync-rotation gates are respected
Source root/helper compensation appears exactly once in meshes/equipment/renderer placement
Actual player and NPC roots share same staging/physical owner; no duplicate body, private pose clock or fake visual=actor getter
Damage/controller reentry cannot advance/publish a second wall sample or corrupt a newly installed retained cursor
limitations: Read-only audit; no new source adapter/runtime edits or new acceptance executions performed.
